summary: SessionBoard's CMS/embeds area lets organizers publish live, self-updating event content into any website. From the admin (Deliver > Embeds > Add Embed) an organizer picks one of five widget types — List of Sessions, List of Speakers, Agenda, Schedule Itinerary, Speaker Gallery — chooses an output format (styled HTML delivered as a single JS script tag rendering a shadow-DOM web component; basic HTML; JSON; XML; iCal), selects which fields appear on cards, sets colors/custom CSS, and applies content filters (tracks, statuses). The public widget renders the event's approved sessions/speakers with an event-title header, keyword search, faceted filters (Format/Track/Location), truncated descriptions with Show more, and drill-down detail views (session detail with subsessions; speaker detail with bio and their sessions). Data auto-refreshes from SessionBoard roughly every 60 minutes, with manual cache refresh; no republish needed. Search scope: itinerary and session list match session titles and speaker names; speaker gallery/list match speaker names only. Personas: organizer configures and embeds; attendees browse, search, filter, and plan their day; developers consume basic HTML/JSON/XML/iCal feeds. Personal-schedule (favoriting) behavior is not visible in the live itinerary embed and is inferred from category norms.
personas: Event organizer / marketer (creates and configures embeds, brands them, curates visible fields and filtered content)
Attendee / event-site visitor (browses sessions and speakers, searches, filters, plans a day itinerary)
Web developer / webmaster (pastes styled-HTML script tag or consumes basic HTML / JSON / XML / iCal feeds)
Speaker (indirect: verifies their public profile, bio, headshot, and session listings render correctly)

features.name: List of Sessions embed
features.description: Embeddable session-catalog widget showing all approved sessions with keyword search (matches session titles and speaker names), faceted Filters panel (Format, Track, Location), result count, and expandable descriptions. Positioned as the catalog view vs the date/time-focused agenda embed. Data pulls live from the event and auto-refreshes (~60 min).
features.ui_expectations: Event-name header; 'Sessions' heading with range count '1 - 22 of 22'; search input placeholder like 'Search by speaker details or session title'; Filters button opening a panel with checkbox facets Format (Session, Roundtable, Lightning Talk), Track (Academia, DEI, Emerging Trends & Innovation, Leadership), Location (Room 305/306/307) and an X to close. Vertical list of cards: session title; truncated abstract with 'Show more' toggle; 'Friday, December 15: 04:00 PM - 05:00 PM'; room; Speakers block listing each speaker's name, job title, company; 'Format:' and 'Track:' tag chips. Filter/search updates list and count in place.

features.name: List of Speakers embed
features.description: Embeddable speaker directory pairing each speaker with their sessions. Sorted alphabetically by surname; search narrows by speaker name (KB: name-only matching; placeholder reads 'Search speakers and sessions'). Each speaker's sessions are listed under their profile and are clickable through to session detail.
features.ui_expectations: Event header; 'Speakers' heading with count '1 - 14 of 14'; search input. Per-speaker entry: circular headshot, name (clickable), job title, company, truncated bio with 'Show more'; beneath, that speaker's sessions each showing title (clickable), 'Thursday, December 14: 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM', room, and 'Roles: speaker'. Speakers with missing photo/title/company render gracefully with fallbacks.

features.name: Agenda embed (grid by location and time)
features.description: Embeddable calendar-grid view of approved sessions organized by location (columns) and time-of-day (rows) for one day at a time, with day navigation and a per-session detail view including subsessions. This is the 'date and time focused view' alternative to the sessions list.
features.ui_expectations: Event header; current day label 'Thu, December 14, 2023' with prev/next chevron nav buttons; column headers per room (Room 305/306/307); left time gutter (8:00 AM-6:00 PM); session blocks positioned at their time slot showing track label, title, room, optional speaker-count badge; non-session items like 'Lunch' appear as blocks. Clicking a block opens a detail view: 'Back' control, title, full 'Thursday, December 14: 01:30 PM - 02:30 PM' range, room, tabs/sections 'Session Details' and 'Subsessions (N)', truncated description with Show more, Format and Track values.

features.name: Schedule Itinerary embed (day-by-day itinerary / personal schedule builder)
features.description: Embeddable chronological itinerary: sessions listed by day in time order with day tabs, keyword search (session titles + speaker names), track/format/location filters, rich cards with full speaker lists and prominent headshot/bio content, and an inline 'View Details' expansion showing timed subsessions. Personal schedule building — starring/adding sessions to a saved 'my schedule' and exporting it — is not visible in SessionBoard's live example and is a category-norm extension (inferred, cf. Sessionize favorites/personal agenda).

Card: track chip, title, truncated description + Show more, full date/time line, room with map-pin icon, clock icon on times, Speakers list (name/title/company for every speaker, up to 8), 'FORMAT:' and 'TRACK:' rows, 'View Details' button that expands inline subsessions (e.g. 'Icebreakers 09:00 AM - 09:15 AM' with sub-speakers) and toggles to 'Hide Details'. Breaks (Lunch) render as speaker-less entries. (inferred) star/add-to-schedule control per card plus a personal-schedule view or iCal/add-to-calendar export.

features.name: Embed generation, formats and branding (organizer side)
features.description: Admin workflow (Deliver module > Embeds > Add Embed) to create any of the five widgets: choose output format — styled HTML delivered as a single JS script line rendering an interactive web component, basic HTML for custom styling, JSON/XML feeds with expanded properties, or iCal subscription of approved sessions; configure display options, colors, optional custom CSS; apply content filters (specific tracks, statuses); pick card fields (required fields locked grey, defaults preselected blue); save to get embed code and preview. Feeds update automatically ~every 60 minutes with a manual cache-refresh option; changing widget data type requires a new embed. rubric.criterion: Sessions List renders a card per session with title, truncated description + Show more, date/time, room, speaker names with job title and company, and Format/Track tags

Wait for widget render; screenshot full list
Pick 3 cards; verify each shows title, description snippet, a date+time string, a room/location, at least one speaker with title+company, and Format and Track values
Click 'Show more' on one card and confirm the description expands

rubric.evidence: Screenshot of list plus screenshot of one card before/after Show more

rubric.criterion: Sessions List keyword search matches session titles AND speaker names, narrowing the list and updating the visible result count

Type a distinctive word from one session title; verify only matching session(s) remain and count updates
Clear; type a speaker surname; verify sessions featuring that speaker remain
rubric.pass_criteria: Both title-term and speaker-name queries filter correctly; count text changes to match

rubric.criterion: Filters panel offers Format, Track and Location facets; applying one narrows the list to matching sessions and can be dismissed

Close panel via X; verify filter persists or clears per UI affordance

rubric.criterion: Speakers List shows entries ordered alphabetically by surname, each with headshot, name, job title, company, truncated bio + Show more, and that speaker's sessions (title, date/time, room, role) beneath

Verify order is alphabetical by last name across first 5 entries
Verify one entry shows photo, name, title, company, bio snippet with Show more
Verify sessions listed under that speaker each show title, date/time, room, and a role label

rubric.criterion: Speakers List search narrows the directory by speaker name and updates the result count

rubric.criterion: Agenda renders a per-day grid with location columns, a time-of-day gutter, and session blocks positioned in the correct room column and time row showing track and title

Cross-check one known fixture session: block appears under its room column adjacent to its start time and shows track label + title

rubric.criterion: Agenda day navigation switches between event days and re-renders the grid with that day's sessions

rubric.criterion: Clicking an agenda block opens a session detail view with full time range, room, description + Show more, Format, Track, and a Subsessions (N) section, with Back returning to the grid

Verify detail view fields: title, 'Day, date: start - end' string, room, description, Format, Track, 'Subsessions (N)'

rubric.criterion: Schedule Itinerary lists sessions chronologically grouped under time headers within day tabs; cards show track chip, title, description, full date/time, room, complete multi-speaker list (name/title/company), and FORMAT/TRACK rows

Click day-2 tab; verify listed sessions change to day 2

rubric.criterion: Personal schedule building (inferred): attendee can star/add sessions to a personal schedule and view/export the selection (e.g. add-to-calendar/iCal)

If present, add 2 sessions and open the personal/my-schedule view; verify only those 2 appear
Look for add-to-calendar/iCal export affordance and click it

rubric.criterion: Speaker Gallery renders a photo-grid of speaker cards (headshot, name, job title, company) ordered alphabetically by surname with a name-only search box
auto_steps: Navigate to speaker-gallery embed page
Verify grid layout and surname A-Z ordering across first 6 cards
Verify card fields; verify the fixture speaker lacking photo/title still renders without breaking layout
Search an exact name; verify grid narrows to that speaker
rubric.pass_criteria: Grid, ordering, card anatomy, missing-data fallback, and name search all correct

rubric.criterion: Clicking a gallery card opens a speaker detail modal with photo, name, title, bio + Show more, Company Name, and a Sessions (N) list showing each session's title, date/time and room; Back/Close returns to the grid
auto_steps: Click a fixture speaker who has 2 sessions
Verify modal fields including 'Sessions (2)' with date/time + room per session
Expand bio via Show more
Close modal; verify grid intact
rubric.pass_criteria: All modal fields present; session count matches fixture; close restores grid
rubric.evidence: Screenshot of open modal and restored grid

rubric.criterion: Organizer can generate each widget as an embeddable snippet in multiple formats (styled HTML single script line, basic HTML, JSON, XML, iCal) with field selection, color/custom-CSS branding, and content filters (e.g. by track/status)
rubric.pass_criteria: Human with an organizer/admin account: open Deliver/Embeds area, click Add Embed, confirm all 5 widget types and >=4 output formats are offered; configure colors + a track filter + deselect an optional field; save, copy the styled-HTML snippet into a blank HTML page, and confirm the widget renders reflecting the chosen colors, filter, and hidden field; confirm JSON/XML endpoints return session/speaker data and iCal imports approved sessions
rubric.evidence: Screenshots of the embed builder, generated snippet, and rendered test page; downloaded .ics import result

rubric.criterion: Embedded widgets stay in sync with source data without republishing: automatic refresh (~60 min) plus a manual cache-refresh action for immediate updates
rubric.pass_criteria: Human: edit a session title in the admin, trigger the embed's manual cache refresh, reload the embedding page and confirm the new title appears; separately confirm (or verify via product docs/config) that embeds poll/refresh automatically on roughly an hourly cadence without any redeploy of the host page
rubric.evidence: Before/after screenshots of the widget showing the edited title and the cache-refresh control

sample_data: One event: '2026 HINOMA Research Annual Conference', 2 days (Thu Dec 14, Fri Dec 15), 3 rooms (Room 305, Room 306, Room 307), hours 8:00 AM-6:00 PM. ~22 approved sessions with formats {Session, Roundtable, Lightning Talk} and tracks {Academia, DEI, Emerging Trends & Innovation, Leadership}; example titles: 'GRADFair: A Career Fair for Graduate Students and Postdocs' (Thu 09:00-10:00, Room 307, Roundtable/Leadership, 8 speakers, contains 3 timed subsessions: Icebreakers 09:00-09:15, Mingle and Connect 09:15-09:30, Closing Remarks 09:45-10:00), 'Funding Graduate Student Internships' (Thu 01:30-02:30 PM, Room 305, Roundtable/Academia, 0 subsessions), 'DEI Professional Development Programming and Best Practices' (Thu 12:00-01:00 PM, Lightning Talk/DEI), plus a speaker-less 'Lunch' break (Thu 12:00-01:00 PM, Room 307). 14 speakers sorted by surname (Abu-Shiraz, Bajaj Singh, Davis, Ferguson, Gaziano, MacDonald, Mohammed, Parker, Pentz, Prakash, Rzhetsky, Wojicki, Woloshyn, Wu) each with headshot URL, job title, company, 2-4 sentence bio, 1-4 session assignments with role 'speaker'; include one edge-case speaker (Tara Ferguson) with no photo/title/company and one placeholder bio ('Write a bio here.') to test fallbacks. Descriptions ~300+ chars to force truncation/Show more.
gaps: Personal schedule builder: despite the name, SessionBoard's live Schedule Itinerary embed shows NO star/favorite/add-to-my-schedule or export control — it is a chronological day-tabbed browse view; the personal-schedule capability in feature emb-schedule-itinerary and EMB-12 is inferred from the assignment framing and category norms (Sessionize favorites, Cvent personal agendas) and weighted low. Organizer-side embed builder UI (Deliver > Embeds wizard, field pickers, formats) is documented only from KB prose, not observed — screens are inferred. JSON/XML feed schemas and iCal contents were not retrievable without an account. Auto-refresh cadence (60 min) and cache-refresh come from KB text only. Search-scope ambiguity: speakers-list placeholder says 'Search speakers and sessions' while KB says speaker-name-only matching for speaker list/gallery; rubric tests name matching only. Whether attendees can filter agenda grid or search within it was not observed (only nav arrows seen). Speaker social links, tag/level/audience custom fields, pagination beyond ~22 items, and mobile-specific layouts were not observable in the examples.
